WHAT_THE_CLASS_IS: reconfiguration problems study the SOLUTION-ADJACENCY GRAPH — whether one can walk between solutions by local moves. That is this program's own object seen from the navigation side. Blend geometry asks whether solutions AVERAGE safely; reconfiguration asks whether they CONNECT.
